bug_semantics: Camel K honors a user-settable Build field (JSON operatorNamespace / BuilderPodNamespace) as the Kubernetes namespace for builder Pod create/get/delete. A namespace-authorized user who can create a Build can therefore spawn operator-privileged builder Pods in another namespace, including the operator namespace (CWE-610/CWE-639).
flaw_origin: 6335618feabac9128f42c2d6ad2d3a289ed4e753 first added BuildSpec.OperatorNamespace and switched pkg/controller/build/build_pod.go from build.Namespace to build.OperatorNamespace() for Pod ObjectMeta.Namespace. Parent 4c6f2a5d411ee6291eda5e36704eed835b8f24a1 still pinned builder Pods to the Build CR namespace and had no operatorNamespace field. Later rename/move to BuildConfiguration.BuilderPodNamespace (bb355e00) is not the first write.
evidence: Apache advisory CVE-2026-45760 remains published (not withdrawn). GHSA-q8ch-jx67-q52x withdrawn_at is null. Real fixes are feat(api): deprecate builder pod namespace: main 72aab0a2d2befb13856ce8a67bbe0ea1536aaade, release-2.10.x 222cdbd80481a4306c76cce66361f0dff07c18bf, 2.9.x 5e70098186b3352297a8515bf43cd48c09404b9b, 2.8.x c8ed78b03977cb1b9908b3b95b4b0c367bdad73f; they stop using the field and pin Pods to build.Namespace. GHSA-listed 1271df0/1efa398/35dd387 are unrelated merge/noise SHAs. BIC 6335618 author/committer Pasquale Congiusti <pasquale.congiusti@gmail.com>; git cat-file -p has no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/bot trailer. Parent tree still uses build.Namespace and lacks operatorNamespace on the scoped API/controller paths. ppa re-checked line-level 2026-08-29: git show 4c6f2a5d:pkg/controller/build/build_pod.go contains zero 'OperatorNamespace' uses and 4c6f2a5d:pkg/apis/camel/v1/build_types.go lacks OperatorNamespace(); the 'Namespace: build.OperatorNamespace()' lines are added by BIC 6335618f -> introducer_parent_absent=true.
reasoning: The vulnerability is real: a user-controlled Build key selects the builder-Pod namespace. The smallest first-write of that key and of its use as Pod.Namespace is human-authored 6335618 (2023-03-01). No AI authorship signal is on that commit object, so the closed verdict is NOT_AI rather than AI_*. Advisory is live, so not FALSE_POSITIVE.
